video_title: Tuomas Iisalo Press Conference | Grizzlies vs. Clippers

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Zack Edey's second-half absence due to soreness
quotes.excerpt: He had some soreness at the end of the second quarter and we decided it's better
quotes.quote: He had some soreness at the end of the second quarter and we decided it's better that he doesn't play in the second half.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo says Zach Edey was held out of the second half against the Clippers due to soreness in his ankle

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo explains that Zach Edey was held out of the second half due to soreness.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Grizzlies' ability to win without shooting well from three
quotes.excerpt: These are very important wins because it shows you that we are robust enough to take care
quotes.quote: These are very important wins because it shows you that we are robust enough to take care of business without having to make shots. That's the worst feeling as a coach if you're coaching a team where you're like, 'Hey, we got to make shots tonight to win the game,' because then you're at the mercy of that. So the opposite of that is winning without making shots. That's a very sustainable way and I loved how our guys competed.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo on the Grizzlies winning despite poor shooting: It is the worst feeling as a coach if you are coaching a team where you feel like you have to make shots to win the game

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo discusses the importance of winning games despite poor three-point shooting performance.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Murray's role and trust as a fifth starter
quotes.excerpt: We just play better when he's out there, which is what ultimately playing basketball is about
quotes.quote: We just play better when he's out there, which is what ultimately playing basketball is about. You're one of five guys who's out there and you try to help the team win as much as possible. He's really doing that through excellent point-of-attack defense. In Charlotte, it was Brandon Miller; today, it was Ingram, really limiting their touches, limiting their efficiency, helping with the rebounding, creating disruption defensively, so contributing to the possession game. And then offensively, he's becoming more and more fluent in how we play.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo praises Chris Murray for his point of attack defense and his ability to limit the efficiency of opposing stars like Brandon Miller and Brandon Ingram

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo praises Kris Murray for his defensive impact against opponents like Brandon Miller and Brandon Ingram.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Spencer's efficiency and consistency off the bench
quotes.excerpt: Efficiency is definitely producing in an efficient way. He's been unreal with his shot making
quotes.quote: Efficiency is definitely producing in an efficient way. He's been unreal with his shot making and again tonight, two for four, seven for ten from the field. He gives us, they both give us, if you look at Ty and Javon and Cam, all of them are very good shooters from the three-point line, also off the dribble, so that forces some reads from the other team and it's really a hard choice for them now.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo highlights the efficiency of Cam Spencer and the bench unit, noting that their ability to shoot off the dribble forces difficult defensive reads from opponents

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo highlights the shooting efficiency and offensive contributions of Cam Spencer, Ty, and Javon.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Zack Edey's ankle injury and precautionary management
quotes.excerpt: We are not there every minute asking how his ankle is doing, so he relayed that message
quotes.quote: We are not there every minute asking how his ankle is doing, so he relayed that message and then the decision was made.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo clarifies that the decision to sit Zach Edey was made after the player relayed concerns about his ankle soreness to the staff

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo clarifies the communication process regarding Zach Edey's ankle injury management.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Tuomas Iisalo on gratitude for his family and career
quotes.excerpt: I'm extremely grateful for my family and for the support. You guys see me coming in
quotes.quote: I'm extremely grateful for my family and for the support. You guys see me coming in to work here every day and do these press conferences or games, but we've lived abroad from our homeland for the last 10 years. I think this is the 11th year that we're away from Finland and our youngest one was born in Germany. We've lived there and my wife left the tenured position as a doctor for me to pursue something that was back then a passion and now is supporting the whole family. I've always thought of it more as a family business instead of it became something different.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo reflects on his career journey and the sacrifices his family has made: I have always thought of it more as a family business instead of it becoming something different

structured.context: Coach Tuomas Iisalo expresses gratitude for his family's support throughout his coaching career abroad.
